4221-shearing-in-the-riverina-new-south-.title: Shearing In The Riverina, New South Wales.
4221-shearing-in-the-riverina-new-south-.creator: Rolf Boldrewood
4221-shearing-in-the-riverina-new-south-.description: A book by Rolf Boldrewood. ms which seemed never tired of arriving. Sheep by thousands, and tens of thousands, began to come, grazing and cropping up to the lonely sandhill--now swarming with blacksmiths, carpenters, engineers, fencers, shepherds, bullock-drivers--till the place looked like a fair on the borders of Tartary.

55129-working-my-way-around-the-world.title: Working My Way Around The World
55129-working-my-way-around-the-world.creator: Unknown
55129-working-my-way-around-the-world.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. After spending some sixteen years in schools and colleges, I decided, one spring, to take a year off and make a trip around the world. I had no money for such a journey; but that didn’t matter for I meant to “work my way” from place to place. I spoke French and German, and had some knowledge of Spanish and Italian.

arxiv-2008-03487.title: Generalized optical theorem for propagation invariant beams
arxiv-2008-03487.creator: Irving Rondón, F. Soto-Eguibar
arxiv-2008-03487.description: Abstract Many practical applications require the analysis of electromagnetic scattering properties of local structures using different sources of illumination. The Optical Theorem (OT) is a useful result in scattering theory, relating the extinction of a structure to the scattering amplitude in the forward direction.

arxiv-2106-10314.title: Differentiable Particle Filtering without Modifying the Forward Pass
arxiv-2106-10314.creator: Adam Ścibior ascibior@cs.ubc.ca, Frank Wood fwood@cs.ubc.ca
arxiv-2106-10314.description: Abstract Particle filters are not compatible with automatic differentiation due to the presence of discrete resampling steps. While known estimators for the score function, based on Fisher’s identity, can be computed using particle filters, up to this point they required manual implementation.

arxiv-2109-01140.title: Vacuum currents in partially compactified Rindler spacetime with an application to cylindrical black holes
arxiv-2109-01140.creator: V. Kh. Kotanjyan, A. A. Saharian, M. R. Setare
arxiv-2109-01140.description: Abstract The vacuum expectation value of the current density for a charged scalar field is investigated in Rindler spacetime with a part of spatial dimensions compactified to a torus. It is assumed that the field is prepared in the Fulling-Rindler vacuum state.

arxiv-2111-13856.title: Benchmarks for quantum computers from Shor’s algorithm
arxiv-2111-13856.creator: E. D. Davis
arxiv-2111-13856.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by E. D. Davis. Properties of Shor’s algorithm and the related period-finding algorithm could serve as benchmarks for the operation of a quantum computer. Distinctive universal behaviour is expected for the probability for success of the period-finding algorithm as the input quantum register is increased through its critical size of 𝔪 0 = ⌈ 2 ​ log 2 ​ r ⌉ \mathfrak{m}_{0}=\lceil 2\log_{2}r\rceil qubits (where r r is the period sought).

arxiv-2112-08183.title: ALMA-IMF II - investigating the origin of stellar masses: Continuum Images and Data Processing
arxiv-2112-08183.creator: A. Ginsburg, T. Csengeri, R. Galván-Madrid, N. Cunningham, R. H. Álvarez-Gutiérrez, T. Baug, M. Bonfand, S. Bontemps, G. Busquet, D. J. Díaz-González, M. Fernández-López, A. Guzmán, F. Herpin, H. Liu, A. López-Sepulcre, F. Louvet, L. Maud, F. Motte, F. Nakamura, T. Nony, F. A. Olguin, Y. Pouteau, P.
arxiv-2112-08183.description: Abstract We present the first data release of the ALMA-IMF Large Program, which covers the 12m-array continuum calibration and imaging. The ALMA-IMF Large Program is a survey of fifteen dense molecular cloud regions spanning a range of evolutionary stages that aims to measure the core mass function (CMF).

arxiv-2205-01406.title: Winding vectors of topological defects: Multiband Chern numbers
arxiv-2205-01406.creator: Axel Fünfhaus, Thilo Kopp, Elias Lettl
arxiv-2205-01406.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Axel Fünfhaus, Thilo Kopp, Elias Lettl. Chern numbers can be calculated within a frame of vortex fields related to phase conventions of a wave function. In a band protected by gaps the Chern number is equivalent to the total number of flux carrying vortices. In the presence of topological defects like Dirac cones this method becomes problematic, in particular if they lack a well-defined winding number. We develop a scheme to include topological defects into the vortex field frame.

arxiv-2207-10558.title: Entanglement and particle fluctuations of one-dimensional chiral topological insulators
arxiv-2207-10558.creator: Kyle Monkman, Jesko Sirker
arxiv-2207-10558.description: Abstract We consider the topological protection of entanglement and particle fluctuations for a general one-dimensional chiral topological insulator with winding number ℐ \mathcal{I} . We prove, in particular, that when the periodic system is divided spatially into two equal halves, the single-particle entanglement spectrum has 2 ​ | ℐ | 2|\mathcal{I}| protected eigenvalues at 1 / 2 1/2 .

arxiv-2210-10679.title: Electronic and Excitonic Properties of MSi 2 {}_{\textrm{2}} Z 4 {}_{\textrm{4}} Monolayers
arxiv-2210-10679.creator: Tomasz Woźniak, Umm-e-hani Asghar, Paulo E. Faria Junior, Muhammad S. Ramzan, Agnieszka B. Kuc
arxiv-2210-10679.description: Abstract M ​ A 2 ​ Z 4 MA_{2}Z_{4} monolayers form a new class of hexagonal non-centrosymmetric materials hosting extraordinary spin-valley physics. While only two compounds (MoSi 2 N 4 and WSi 2 N 4 ) were recently synthesized, theory predicts interesting (opto)electronic properties of a whole new family of such two-dimensional materials.

arxiv-2212-03725.title: Learning-To-Embed: Adopting Transformer based models for E-commerce Products Representation Learning
arxiv-2212-03725.creator: Lakshya Kumar, Sreekanth Vempati
arxiv-2212-03725.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Lakshya Kumar, Sreekanth Vempati. Learning low-dimensional representation for large number of products present in an e-commerce catalogue plays a vital role as they are helpful in tasks like product ranking, product recommendation, finding similar products, modelling user-behaviour etc. Recently, a lot of tasks in the NLP field are getting tackled using the Transformer based models and these deep models are widely applicable in the industries setting to solve various problems.

arxiv-2312-14092.title: Solar Eruptions Triggered by Flux Emergence Below or Near a Coronal Flux Rope
arxiv-2312-14092.creator: Tibor Török, M. G. Linton, J. E. Leake, Z. Mikić, R. Lionello, V. S. Titov, C. Downs
arxiv-2312-14092.description: Abstract Observations have shown a clear association of filament/prominence eruptions with the emergence of magnetic flux in or near filament channels. Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) simulations have been employed to systematically study the conditions under which such eruptions occur. These simulations to date have modeled filament channels as two-dimensional (2D) flux ropes or 3D uniformly sheared arcades.

arxiv-2401-06957.title: EVOKE: Emotion Enabled Virtual Avatar Mapping Using Optimized Knowledge Distillation Thanks: ‡ Authors with equal contributions.
arxiv-2401-06957.creator: Maryam Nadeem 1 , Raza Imam 1 3 , Rouqaiah Al-Refai 1 3 , Meriem Chkir 1 , Mohamad Hoda 1 2 and Abdulmotaleb El Saddik 1 2
arxiv-2401-06957.description: Abstract As virtual environments continue to advance, the demand for immersive and emotionally engaging experiences has grown. Addressing this demand, we introduce E motion enabled V irtual avatar mapping using O ptimized K nowledg E distillation (EVOKE), a lightweight emotion recognition framework designed for the seamless integration of emotion recognition into 3D avatars within virtual environments.

arxiv-2403-17092.title: A Unified CPU-GPU Protocol for GNN Training Conference: 21st ACM International Conference on Computing Frontiers; May 7–9, 2024; Ischia, Italy 21st ACM International Conference on Computing Frontiers (CF ’24), May 7–9, 2024, Ischia, Italy DOI: 10.1145/3649153.3649191 ISBN: 979-8-4007-0597-7/24/05 CC
arxiv-2403-17092.creator: Yi-Chien Lin, Gangda Deng, Viktor Prasanna
arxiv-2403-17092.description: Abstract . Training a Graph Neural Network (GNN) model on large-scale graphs involves a high volume of data communication and computations. While state-of-the-art CPUs and GPUs feature high computing power, the Standard GNN training protocol adopted in existing GNN frameworks cannot efficiently utilize the platform resources.

arxiv-2405-18459.title: Probing the Information Theoretical Roots of Spatial Dependence Measures
arxiv-2405-18459.creator: Zhangyu Wang, Krzysztof Janowicz, Gengchen Mai, Ivan Majic
arxiv-2405-18459.description: Abstract Intuitively, there is a relation between measures of spatial dependence and information theoretical measures of entropy. For instance, we can provide an intuition of why spatial data is special by stating that, on average, spatial data samples contain less than expected information. Similarly, spatial data, e.g.

arxiv-2412-08735.title: Restricted Monte Carlo wave function method and Lindblad equation for identifying entangling open-quantum-system dynamics
arxiv-2412-08735.creator: Laura Ares, Julien Pinske, Benjamin Hinrichs, Martin Kolb, Jan Sperling
arxiv-2412-08735.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Laura Ares, Julien Pinske, Benjamin Hinrichs, Martin Kolb, Jan Sperling. We develop an extension of the Monte Carlo wave function approach that unambiguously identifies dynamical entanglement in general composite, open systems. Our algorithm performs tangential projections onto the set of separable states, leading to classically correlated quantum trajectories. By comparing this restricted evolution with the unrestricted one, we can characterize the entangling capabilities of quantum channels without making use of input-output relations.

arxiv-2508-01750.title: LLM-Assisted Model-Based Fuzzing of Protocol Implementations
arxiv-2508-01750.creator: Changze Huang, Di Wang, Zhi Quan Zhou
arxiv-2508-01750.description: Abstract . Testing network protocol implementations is critical for ensuring the reliability, security, and interoperability of distributed systems. Faults in protocol behavior can lead to vulnerabilities and system failures, especially in real-time and mission-critical applications. A common approach to protocol testing involves constructing Markovian models that capture the state transitions and expected behaviors of the protocol.

arxiv-2508-09952.title: Specialised or Generic? Tokenization Choices for Radiology Language Models
arxiv-2508-09952.creator: Hermione Warr, Wentian Xu, Harry Anthony, Yasin Ibrahim, Daniel R. McGowan, Konstantinos Kamnitsas
arxiv-2508-09952.description: Abstract The vocabulary used by language models (LM) - defined by the tokenizer - plays a key role in text generation quality. However, its impact remains under-explored in radiology. In this work, we address this gap by systematically comparing general, medical, and domain-specific tokenizers on the task of radiology report summarisation across three imaging modalities.

arxiv-2510-11907.title: Task-Specific Dual-Model Framework for Comprehensive Traffic Safety Video Description and Analysis
arxiv-2510-11907.creator: Blessing A. Kyem, Neema J. Owor, Andrews Danyo, Joshua K. Asamoah, Eugene Denteh, Tanner Muturi, Anthony Dontoh, Yaw Adu-Gyamfi, Armstrong Aboah, North Dakota State University, First Authors
arxiv-2510-11907.description: Abstract Traffic safety analysis requires complex video understanding to capture fine-grained behavioral patterns and generate comprehensive descriptions for accident prevention. In this work, we present a unique dual-model framework that strategically utilizes the complementary strengths of VideoLLaMA and Qwen2.5-VL through task-specific optimization to address this issue.

plos-pone-0002970.description: PLOS ONE research article. Little information exists regarding the burden of HIV among tuberculosis patients in India, and no population-based surveys have been previously reported. A community-based HIV prevalence survey was conducted among tuberculosis patients treated by the national tuberculosis contro

pmc-11393349.title: Exploring the synergistic effects of vitamin D and synbiotics on cytokines profile, and treatment response in breast cancer: a pilot randomized clinical trial
pmc-11393349.creator: Aliasghar Tirgar, Masoud Rezaei, Mohammadhadi Ehsani, Zahra Salmani, Armin Rastegari, Elham Jafari, Behjat Kalantari Khandani, Nouzar Nakhaee, Mohammad Khaksari, Vahid Moazed
pmc-11393349.description: This study was designed to investigate the effect of vitamin D and/or synbiotics on the response to treatment, cytokines profile and hormonal biomarkers in breast cancer patients undergoing neoadjuvant therapy. A total of 76 patients were recruited and completed the course of the intervention between 2019 and 2021 in Kerman, Iran. breast cancer patients were randomly enrolled in this study.

pmc-11570432.title: Exploring Nomophobia: A Cross-Sectional Study on the Prevalence Among College Students in the Chengalpattu District, India
pmc-11570432.creator: Rajan Edward Daniel Thomas, Harishma Ramesh, Arun Kumar R, Vinoth Gnana Chellaiyan, Sanjutha A
pmc-11570432.description: IntroductionNomophobia, also known as “NO MObile PHone Phobia,” is a psychological ailment in which people are afraid of losing access to their mobile phones. This study aims to fill this gap by conducting a cross-sectional investigation into the prevalence of nomophobia among college students in the Chengalpattu district.

pmc-12489861.title: PGC1A Restores Mitochondrial Health to Attenuate EMT During Lens Epithelial Fibrosis via Regulating TFAM
pmc-12489861.creator: Jingqi Huang, Peiyi Jiang, Baoxin Chen, Mi Huang, Jieping Chen, Jiani Wang, Shan Huang, Yizhi Liu
pmc-12489861.description: PurposeEpithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) of lens epithelial cells (LECs) is a predominant pathological driver for fibrotic cataracts. This study explores the role and mechanism of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor γ coactivator 1-α (PGC1A), a key mitochondrial regulator, in EMT of LECs.MethodsRNA-sequencing analysis was applied to reveal biological changes during human lens epithelial fibrosis.

pmc-13087444.title: Comparing Whole‐Blood and Plasma Tacrolimus Intra‐Patient Variability for Predicting Allograft Rejection in Kidney Transplantation
pmc-13087444.creator: Zeyu Xia, Hui Yu, Jeong M Park, Hao‐Jie Zhu
pmc-13087444.description: Tacrolimus is a key immunosuppressant used to prevent allograft rejection in kidney transplant recipients. Intra‐patient variability (IPV) in tacrolimus trough concentrations has been recognized as a useful biomarker for predicting clinical outcomes in kidney transplantation. Tacrolimus therapeutic drug monitoring traditionally relies on whole‐blood concentration measurements.

pmc-13118115.title: Personal Protective Equipment Immediately Alters the Core–Skin Temperature Gradient in Recruit Firefighters
pmc-13118115.creator: William R. Kinnaird, Andrew R. Moore, Tiffany J. Oberther, A. Maleah Winkler
pmc-13118115.description: The purpose of this study was to quantify the degree to which personal protective equipment (PPE) affects the core–skin temperature gradient in nine recruit firefighters attending fire academy. Participants wore a chest monitor and ingested a pill to continually measure skin and core temperature, respectively.

pmc-13296141.title: Auditory Perception and Psychosocial Well-Being in Long-Term Cochlear Implant Users
pmc-13296141.creator: Kadriye Guney, Ozlem Topcu, Patrizia Mancini, Hilal Dincer D’Alessandro
pmc-13296141.description: Background/Objectives: This study investigated auditory perception and psychosocial well-being in long-term cochlear implant (CI) users, with a particular focus on the effects of auditory (re)habilitation on learned helplessness and speech-in-noise perception, representing everyday listening performance. Methods: Thirty CI users and thirty peers with typical hearing (TH) participated in the study.

pmc-13454079.title: Association between serum chemerin and breast cancer mediated by lipid metabolism
pmc-13454079.creator: Hui Li, Qunying Xu, Mingquan Huang, Jing Shu, Siyi Chen, Jia Xia, Ya Liu, Yunli Ye
pmc-13454079.description: BackgroundThe association between chemerin and breast cancer is unclear. We aimed to clarify the association between serum chemerin levels and breast cancer risk in Chinese women, as well as the effects of lipid metabolism on this association.MethodsA 1:1 matched case–control study of 160 pairs was conducted using questionnaires to collect data on breast cancer risk factors.
